hero.valor: 4th year Computer Engineering student passionate about backend development, with internship experience and academic projects that demonstrate my ability to learn quickly and solve complex problems.

sobreMi.descripcion1: I'm a 4th-year Computer Engineering student at the University of Murcia. I've always been curious about how things work under the hood, which led me to dive into backend development and artificial intelligence.
sobreMi.descripcion2: I learn by doing—testing, breaking, and rebuilding. I enjoy working in teams, sharing ideas, and finding creative ways to solve real-world problems. During my internship I got hands-on experience with taking a project from start to finish, from coding to documentation.
sobreMi.descripcion3: I had the chance to live in the United States, which helped me improve my English and broaden my perspective. Looking ahead, I want to keep growing as a developer, explore new technologies, and build software that truly makes an impact. I'm also open to opportunities abroad and excited about working in international environments.

experiencia.descripcion: My most relevant experience in the field of software development.

practicas.descripcion: I worked on the research and development of a payment module for PrestaShop using GNU Taler. My tasks included configuring the merchant backend and database, integrating the plugin through REST endpoints, running end-to-end payment and refund tests, and preparing technical documentation supported by a video tutorial and a GitLab repository.
achievements: Implemented a fully functional payment system for PrestaShop
Produced technical documentation and a video tutorial
Delivered a complete payment workflow tested and validated in real scenarios

proyectos.descripcion: A selection of my most outstanding university projects, demonstrating my experience in software development, intelligent systems, and communication networks.

appchat.subtitulo: Full-featured chat application with contact, message, and user profile management
appchat.reto: Develop a robust chat application with advanced features and data persistence.
appchat.solucion: I implemented a complete application using Java and Maven, with JPA for persistence, JUnit for testing, and external libraries for advanced features.
appchat.impacto: Grade 9.5. Functional app with PDF report generation for premium users and efficient dependency management.

mitologia.subtitulo: Intelligent system to answer complex questions about Greek mythology
mitologia.reto: Create a system integrating ontologies and rule engines to model complex mythological domains.
mitologia.solucion: We developed a team prototype using Protégé for ontologies and Drools as a rule engine, capable of evaluating mythological event sequences.
mitologia.impacto: Grade 9.75. System able to generate complex answers about mythological feats and decisions.

nanofiles.subtitulo: Distributed P2P system for sharing and transferring files between users
nanofiles.reto: Implement a hybrid system combining a centralized server with direct P2P connections for efficient file transfer.
nanofiles.solucion: We developed a Java system with a centralized server managing users and files, and direct P2P connections using TCP for secure transfers.
nanofiles.impacto: Grade 10. Complete system with user registration, file publishing/downloading, and concurrent connection handling.

trilingo.subtitulo: Desktop application to create and complete interactive courses.
trilingo.reto: Develop a platform to create, manage, and complete courses with varied exercises, saving user progress and statistics.
trilingo.solucion: Implemented in Java 21 and JavaFX, MVVM architecture with mvvmFX, persistence with JPA and SQLite, support for importing/exporting courses in JSON, and course creation via GUI.
trilingo.impacto: Enables personalized and collaborative learning, allowing users to create and share courses, and consult progress statistics.

proyectosPersonales.intro: Personal projects focused on web development, data analysis, and machine learning. Each one serves as a practical example of applying different technologies and best practices in real-world scenarios.

portfolio.descripcion: Development of my portfolio website using Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. Includes sections for projects, experience, and contact form.
portfolio.reto: Create a modern and responsive website to showcase my professional profile.
portfolio.solucion: I used Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind for a fast and customizable experience.
portfolio.impacto: Professional online portfolio, improving my digital presence.

tennisPredictor.descripcion: Professional tennis match prediction using machine learning.
tennisPredictor.reto: Build an accurate model and analyze key victory factors.
tennisPredictor.solucion: Data pipeline, feature engineering, and advanced models.
tennisPredictor.impacto: Reliable predictions for sports analysis and betting.
